mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_agent_definition WHERE id=#{id} AND del_flag=0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.*, COALESCE(p.version,0) active_version, COALESCE(s.call_count,0) call_count, COALESCE(s.total_input_tokens,0) total_input_tokens, COALESCE(s.total_output_tokens,0) total_output_tokens, s.total_cached_tokens FROM t_agent_definition a LEFT JOIN t_agent_release p ON p.id=a.active_release_id AND p.del_flag=0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.agent_id, COUNT(*) call_count, SUM(r.input_tokens) total_input_tokens, SUM(r.output_tokens) total_output_tokens, SUM(r.cached_tokens) total_cached_tokens FROM t_agent_run r WHERE r.del_flag=0 AND r.agent_id=#{id} AND r.agent_id IN (SELECT id FROM t_agent_definition WHERE code=#{code} AND del_flag=0) GROUP BY r.agent_id ) s ON s.agent_id=a.id WHERE a.del_flag=0 AND a.id=#{id} AND a.code=#{code} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1000
